messages:
mina_support: customer on prod-us reported a surge of 500/502s and 2000ms+ p95 from their webhook calls after last night's routing changes. They claim requests are hitting eu clusters instead of us-east. sample req id: req_0a1b2c3d. They see auth failures (token mismatch) and billing cross-region egress.

raj_infra: can you paste a request id + raw headers (no token) and approximate time? we need to confirm path + host that got routed to eu.

mina_support: sure — req_0a1b2c3d at 2025-07-12T03:12Z. headers: 
Host: api.redwood.example
X-Redwood-Region: us-east-1
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Cookie: session=abc123; Path=/; HttpOnly
User-Agent: curl/7.85

lucy_eng: quick check of the envoy access log for that req shows upstream_cluster="region-eu" and status=502. interestingly the downstream header X-Redwood-Region was present on the incoming request but not forwarded to upstream — looks like it was removed during a redirect/set-cookie flow.

lucy_eng: log excerpt:
"2025-07-12T03:12:09.342Z method=POST path=/v1/webhook status=502 upstream_cluster=region-eu response_flags=\"UC\" x_forwarded_for=1.2.3.4 x-redwood-region=us-east-1"

lucy_eng: hypothesis: recent L7 host_rewrite + set_cookie rotation we shipped last night may be rewriting host and dropping preserve_external_request_headers for cookie-based routes. Envoy can drop custom headers across a 302/301 if the redirect path triggers a different route with host_rewrite enabled.

deploy-bot: deploy "l7-host-rewrite-v2" succeeded 2025-07-12T01:45Z on canary (10%). No rollbacks.

sam_network: if it's a 302 loop / redirect -> upstream mismatch then the client exchanges cookies and the new request gets a region-less path that matches eu cluster. quick workaround: add a request header passthrough filter to preserve X-Redwood-Region across rewrites, or disable host_rewrite on the affected vhost.

eva_platform: customer reports billing spike due to cross-region egress. finance flagged a ~12% increase from that account. we should notify billing and consider temporary credit if root cause confirmed.

raj_infra: reproduction steps I ran locally:
1) curl -v -H 'X-Redwood-Region: us-east-1' -H 'Host: api.redwood.example' -X POST https://edge.example/v1/webhook -d '{"ping":1}' -i
2) edge responded 302 -> Location: https://eu-edge.example/v1/webhook and Set-Cookie: session=def456; Path=/;
3) follow-up request hits eu cluster and bearer token validation fails (issuer mismatch) -> 401/502 depending on flow

raj_infra: created a minimal repro script and attached it to the support ticket.

lucy_eng: root cause (likely): the host_rewrite rule in l7-host-rewrite-v2 doesn't preserve custom headers when route selection changes due to Set-Cookie-induced redirect. Envoy route matching moves request to a different virtual host and our listener config omits preserve_external_request_headers for that host.

toby_sre: immediate mitigation: rollback l7-host-rewrite-v2 in canary and bump to 0% until we patch. Also push a temporary global header-preserve policy (edge filter) so downstream upstreams receive X-Redwood-Region and Authorization intact across redirects. I'll own the rollback if eng approves.

lucy_eng: patch plan: update envoy virtual host config to set "preserve_external_request_headers: true" and ensure host_rewrite does not trigger a vhost swap for same-tenant requests. add integration test covering Set-Cookie + host_rewrite flows. target hotfix release in next 2 hours.

sam_network: onboarding note — double-check cookie Path and SameSite; our redirect removed SameSite=None in the rewrite which caused some browsers to drop cookies. that may explain partial repros.

mina_support: I've informed the customer and offered a temporary credit. they can flip to our eu model intentionally but want correct route behavior. ticket updated with repro script and request ids.

eva_platform: finance ok with a small credit conditional on root cause report. please cc finance when you close.

toby_sre: rolling back now (canary -> 0%). will monitor metrics (error rate, cross-region egress) and post updates in this thread.

lucy_eng: after rollback metrics look back to baseline for canary. will proceed with patch and smoke tests; will open a PR for the envoy config change and link it here.

mina_support: thanks all — marking as high-priority P1 for now. I'll follow up with customer after patch + rollback confirmation.
